Strict method response vocabulary is checked before signing/journaling and on client verification. Extra private result/progress fields, malformed response status and inconsistent public status combinations are rejected.
assumptions: Snapshot/catalog identity, shape, availability metadata, enrolled authority state, budget/control history and request ordering are part of the authorized public plan for this reference. If their existence is sensitive, the public-policy classification must be revisited.
Private datasets are represented by the same fixed 3-user roster and public 4-bucket catalog. Eight count datasets differ only by each user presence slot.
Matched public random coins and valid K40 random tapes are used to produce identical approved count output 1; cancelled jobs have no output. This is conditional testing, not a new noise distribution.

Normal trace comparisons cover complete signed application requests/responses and delivery/receipt bytes. They exclude TLS ciphertext, CPU/storage/transport timing, packetization, health/overload and full arbitrary-adversary observation.

runtime_trace_comparison.scope: Exact equality of complete signed application request/response and delivery/receipt bytes under matched public coins and valid count tapes coupled to output 1. No equality claim for TLS ciphertext, runtime timing, traces with differing approved results, all random tapes or arbitrary adversaries.

network_negative_controls.scope: Actual loopback mTLS. Deliberate private-bit-dependent dispatch mutants after already released identical approved output. These are negative controls, not claimed defects present in normal dispatch. Generic rejection cannot repair an implicit private-data branch; connection closure is also observable.

network.scope: Actual loopback mTLS public challenge/submit/poll/cancel/final calls, socket response loss, authenticated witness, fresh replica exact response recovery. Trusted local scheduler plus full histogram result over separate mTLS recipient and authenticated recipient witness, followed by signed public final page. All services share one host/CA and synthetic keys.

counterexample_interpretation: The deliberately mutated dispatcher reads one private presence bit after identical approved output. Conditional STORAGE_INTEGRITY yields POLL versus connection closure; reusing the generic GW_PAYLOAD policy code yields POLL versus REJECTED. Matching error strings does not remove the branch. Normal dispatcher is not claimed to contain these injected branches; negative controls test the observation claim and fault assumptions.
